changes: First Modwerk release for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, on Core 2.1. Snap native SRC start, end and loop markers to nearby zero crossings. In the normal recording editor, apply an adjustable loop crossfade with one-level undo.
Source-only exports compiled with the pinned GCC 16.2 toolchain; every one of the 63 feature selections per OS links with Core 2.1 to the native Elekloader MAIN byte for byte.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
